sloka: एतेन शतशो देवा दानवाश्च पराजिताः।रक्षितानि च रक्षांसि यक्षाश्चापि निषूदिताः ।। ६.७१.३३ ।।
transliteration: etena śataśo devā dānavāśca parājitāḥ।rakṣitāni ca rakṣāṁsi yakṣāścāpi niṣūditāḥ ।। 6.71.33 ।।

translations.english: "By this (boon) hundreds of Devatas and demons were defeated by him, Yakshas were killed, nay Rakshasas were protected."
